company: West Red Lake Gold Mines Ltd.
data_status: complete — FY2025 audited financial statements + Jan 7, 2025 PFS release + Apr 23, 2026 annual operating & financial summary and Jan 12, 2026 commercial production release read.

mines.mine_notes: 100%-owned underground gold mine, Red Lake district, Ontario; fully permitted at 800 tpd. Ramp-up through 2025: ~20,000 oz contained gold produced at avg realized C$5,170/oz; Dec 2025 mill averaged 689 tpd (86% of permitted 800 tpd) at 4.94 g/t head grade and 94.6% recovery (3,215 oz). Commercial production declared Jan 12, 2026 (effective Jan 1, 2026). 2026 guidance: 35,000–45,000 oz at cash costs US$2,400–3,100/oz sold and mine AISC US$2,800–3,600/oz sold. PFS (Jan 7, 2025, SRK): after-tax NPV C$315M, IRR 255%, AISC US$1,681/oz, initial capital C$44.1M, sustaining capital C$434M @ US$2,200/oz Au. Reserve grade 8.16 g/t; M&I resource grade 7.4 g/t.

notes: FY2025 (12 months ended Dec 31, 2025; 2024 was 13 months): revenue C$103.4M (gold), income from mining operations C$45.3M, net income C$0.5M (vs loss C$115.8M in 2024); cash C$42.4M + gold receivables C$7.9M = ~C$48M per company summary; total assets C$273.8M; liabilities C$176.7M; credit facility C$28.3M (curr + non-curr); gold-linked notes C$44.9M; equity C$97.1M. Madsen was exploration-stage pre-2025; first gold revenue 2025. ~C$35.7M weighted-average shares outstanding (basic EPS $0.00). Registered office: Suite 3123, 595 Burrard Street, Vancouver BC V7X 1J1. Tickers: TSXV:WRLG / OTCQB:WRLGF / FSE:UJO.
